 Here are the Predictions for Nepal Premier League 2026 , 22nd Match - Biratnagar Kings vs Pokhara Avengers and 23rd Match - Karnali Yaks vs Lumbini Lions, to be played on the 12th of November at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur.
 Match Prediction - Biratnagar Kings v Pokhara Avengers 
 22nd Match - Biratnagar Kings vs Pokhara Avengers (Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average 1st Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 157 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 137 
 Current Form Pokhara Avengers:
 Pokhara Avengers are currently placed at the bottom most position on points table with 1 win and 4 losses to their credit. They have 2 points to their name. Their NRR is -0.707.
 The top run scorer for Pokhara Avengers in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Kushal Bhurtel with 136 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Pokhara Avengers in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Mahedi Hasan with 5 scalps under his belt.
 Pokhara Avengers have won their previous match against Karnali Yaks by a huge margin of 63 runs.
 Pokhara Avengers batted first and they posted a massive total of 217 for 3 in 20 overs. Mahedi Hasan got out cheaply. After his dismissal, Yuvraj Samra and Kushal Bhurtel showcased all range of shots in their book. Samra made 102 runs off 48 balls, hitting 10 fours and 6 sixes. Bhurtel also played to his potential and scored 62 runs in only 39 deliveries. Chamika Karunaratne played a whirlwind cameo of 39 runs in only 11 balls at the back end to propel Pokhara Avengers to a massive total of 217.
 During the chase, Karnali Yaks lost their way right from the outset. They were reduced to 69 for 5 in the 8th over and looked in all sorts of bother. Mahedi Hasan bowled exceptionally well. He picked up 3 wickets for just 24 runs to trigger the collapse. Pawan Sarraf fought hard but kept losing partners in regular succession. Karnali Yaks couldn't really stage a comeback and they were eventually bowled out for 154, losing the match by a big margin of 63 runs.
 Current Form Biratnagar Kings:
 Biratnagar Kings are currently placed at the 6th position on points table with 2 wins and 3 losses to their credit. They have 4 points to their name. Their NRR is -0.820.
 The top run scorer for Biratnagar Kings in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Lokesh Bam with 194 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Biratnagar Kings in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Angelo Mathews with 7 scalps under his belt.
 Biratnagar Kings have lost their previous match against Kathmandu Gorkhas by 9 wickets.
 Biratnagar Kings batted first and they posted a total of 83 before being bowled out. Lokesh Bam and Shehan Jayasuriya got out without troubling the scorers much. Imran Sheikh also disappointed and threw his wicket quite early. Angelo Mathews got the start but failed to convert it into a bigger. Biratnagar Kings always looked out of gas and kept losing wickets in regular succession. Santosh Yadav bowled exceptionally well. He picked up 3 wickets for 11 runs and helped bowl Biratnagar Kings out for just 83.
 During the chase, Kathmandu Gorkhas lost the key wicket of Sahil Patel quite early. After his dismissal, David Warner and William Bosisto played really well. Warner made 44 while Bosisto scored 23 runs. Both stayed not out and steered Kathmandu Gorkhas to victory in the 10th over itself with 9 wickets in hand.

 Current Form Lumbini Lions:
 Lumbini Lions are currently placed at the 3rd position on points table with 3 wins, 1 loss and 1 No Result Match to their credit. They have 7 points to their name. Their NRR is 1.501.
 The top run scorer for Lumbini Lions in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Rohit Kumar Paudel with 190 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Lumbini Lions in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Sher Malla with 8 scalps under his belt.
 Lumbini Lions have lost their previous match against Kathmandu Gorkhas by 36 runs.
 Kathmandu Gorkhas batted first and they posted a competitive total of 160 for 8 in 20 overs. Sahil Patel and David Warner started off very well for Kathmandu Gorkhas. They collected 104 runs for the 1st wicket partnership and completely dominated the opposition bowlers. Patel made 38 while Warner scored 66 runs in 50 deliveries. Sahan Arachchige also contributed very well with a whirlwind knock of 34 runs in only 15 balls to help Kathmandu Gorkhas get to 160 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Lumbini Lions lost 4 early wickets and looked to be in deep waters. Sundeep Jora fought hard and scored 44 runs but he too consumed 45 deliveries and it didn't help the team much. The lower order batters also gave up their arms too soon and Lumbini Lions were eventually bowled out for 124, losing the match by 36 runs.
